div.head: VI Atr 10.2
div.ab: Ac æghwilce dæde toscade man wærlice ⁊ dom æfter dæde medemige be mæþe, swa for Gode sy gebeorhlic ⁊ for worolde aberendlic.
Ac æghwilce dæde toscade man wærlice and dom æfter dæde medemige be mæþe, swa for Gode sy gebeorhlic and for worolde aberendlic.
But every deed shall be carefully distinguished and judgment meted out in proportion to the offence, as shall be justifiable in the sight of God and acceptable in the eyes of men.
But each deed is to be carefully weighed and judgment appropriate to the deed handed down in such a way as shall be justifiable before God and acceptable to the community.
Sondern jede That unterscheide man vorsichtig und ermässige das Urtheil gemäss der That nach Verhältniss, wie es sich vor Gott verantworten und im Staat ertragen lässt.
But let every deed be carefully distinguished, and the judgment moderated in proportion to the deed, as can be justified before God and tolerated in the world.
